SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.130

Fix: the Report category pickers showed the list as it was when you signed in. A category added later was missing until you signed in again or reloaded. That includes ones added under Report categories, in the Treasurer's report setup, on another computer or by another user.
Now each picker reads the current list when the form opens. New categories show up, and ones made inactive drop off. A form that already has a category chosen keeps it.
